newsitem.title: USA: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-SAINTS SIGN RECEIVER HASTINGS, THREE OTHER FREE AGENTS.
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-SAINTS SIGN RECEIVER HASTINGS, THREE OTHER FREE AGENTS.

text.p: The New Orleans Saints announced the signing of free agent receivers Andre Hastings and Randal Hill, centre Jerry Fontenot and cornerback Mickey Washington on Wednesday, and released receivers Michael Haynes and Torrance Small.

The moves continue new coach Mike Ditka's reshaping of the offence. The Saints released veteran quarterback Jim Everett two weeks ago after they acquired Heath Shuler from the Washington Redskins in April.

Hastings, Hill and Washington all agreed to two-year contracts with an option at the end of their first year. Fontenot agreed to a two-year, no option contract, the club said. Financial terms were not disclosed.
Haynes and Small were the starting receivers for the Saints last year, but combined for just 94 catches for 1,344 yards and six touchdowns.

The 26-year-old Hastings enjoyed the best season of his four-year career with the Pittsburgh Steelers in 1996, catching 72 passes for 739 yards and six touchdowns. He will likely start for New Orleans alongside Haywood Jeffires.
Hill, 27, had 21 catches for 409 yards and four touchdowns last year for the Miami Dolphins. He will likely serve as the Saints' third receiver.

The 30-year-old Fontenot played the first eight years of his NFL career with the Chicago Bears, including four seasons under Ditka. The Saints may shift centre Andy McCollum to right guard to make room for Fontenot.

Washington, 28, started at left cornerback for the Jacksonville Jaguars last year, but was released by the team after the season. He would likely serve as a nickel back and backup corner to Saint starters Eric Allen and Alex Moulden.
